title: Keeping the hike itself in the track
description: The extra tail can be trimmed, and fragments split by accident can be put back together while the originals are kept.

blocks.text: The timer can go on recording once you are in the car, or stop during a break.

quote.text: Relive discontinued the functionality to trim routes. If you forget to stop recording after an activity, it records everything until you remember to “finish” making the data and map useless. Please fix this because it is a deal breaker.

blocks.text: Show the time by segment and let an edit be compared with the full recording. When fragments are joined, keep the interval with no data visible.
A correction helps convey what the walk was, and it should not quietly draw in a path that was never there.
